items.title: Review the t3-start-thread helper's architecture for deep modules and over-engineering

checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
report = root / 'docs/reviews/2026-10-22-t3-start-thread-architecture-review.md'
text = report.read_text()
baseline = '8e45bbda384ace41013fce0cd8f4c7105dfec9bb'
assert baseline in text
assert re.findall(r'^## (.+)$', text, re.M)[-1] == 'Draft issues'
assert all(len(h) <= 60 for h in re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', text, re.M))
assert re.findall(r'^- \*\*F(\d)', text, re.M) == ['1', '2', '3', '4']
assert re.findall(r'^- \*\*D(\d)', text, re.M) == ['1', '2', '3', '4']
assert '**D1, D2, then D3**' in text
for block in re.split(r'^- \*\*D\d', text, flags=re.M)[1:]:
    for required in ('**Work:**', '**Acceptance:**', '**Overlap:**', '**Live T3 needed:**'):
        assert required in block, required
for block in re.split(r'^- \*\*F\d', text, flags=re.M)[1:]:
    assert '][code]' in block or '][tests]' in block
    assert '**Recommendation:**' in block
refs = dict(re.findall(r'^\[([^\]]+)\]: (\S+)$', text, re.M))
used = set(re.findall(r'\]\[([^\]]+)\]', text))
assert used <= refs.keys(), used - refs.keys()
for name, target in refs.items():
    assert not target.startswith(('/', 'http:', 'https:')), target
    assert (report.parent / target.split('#')[0]).is_file(), target
for target in ('t3-start-thread/scripts/start_thread.py', 't3-start-thread/tests/test_start_thread.py', 't3-start-thread/SKILL.md', 't3-start-thread/references/helper.md'):
    original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{baseline}:{target}'])
    assert original == (root / target).read_bytes(), target
# Check every explicit source-line citation against the baseline's file size.
for label, name in re.findall(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\[(code|tests|skill|reference)\]', text):
    if ', lines ' not in label:
        continue
    count = len((report.parent / refs[name]).read_text().splitlines())
    for n in re.findall(r'\d+', label.split(', lines ', 1)[1]):
        assert 1 <= int(n) <= count, (name, n, count)
assert '/home/' not in text and 'http://hopeli' not in text and 'http://atom' not in text
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check'], check=True)
print('PASS: baseline sources, citations, links, four ranked findings/drafts, first-three order, overlap/live labels, final section and whitespace')
PY
git show --format= --check HEAD
unshare -rn env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --offline --no-project --with pytest==9.1.1 --with websocket-client==1.9.2 pytest -p no:cacheprovider t3-start-thread/tests -q
